title: Every Extra Term Buys A Little More Distance
summary: A truncated Taylor series is the function minus a remainder you can bound before computing anything. Add terms and watch the trusted interval widen, until a singularity stops it widening for good.

sources.title: Rudin, Principles of Mathematical Analysis, 3rd ed., Theorem 5.15 (Taylor's theorem)
NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, section 1.4(vi), Taylor's theorem with remainder
